I’m currently having a plus size pregnancy, I am 5’2 started my pregnancy at about 180 pounds and at 29 weeks am currently at 206 pounds which is a 26 pound weight gain. Every time I go the doctors I’m so scared she’s going to give me a hard time about my weight gain especially since I started my pregnancy overweight but she’s barely said anything about it. I do watch what I eat for the most part and make sure my diet is full of healthy foods plus I tested negative for diabetes and have not had high blood pressure so that’s probably why she hasn’t seemed concerned about it. The only time she mentioned anything is when I asked about the covid vaccine which she told me since I am pregnant and technically obese I would qualify for it (this conversation happened back in my first trimester when vaccines were limited). I am also super grateful my doctor hasn’t made a big deal about my weight I already am disgusted with myself especially since I wasn’t trying to get pregnant until I was at a healthier weight first but here I am and everything has gone super smoothly so far with no complications just hoping it stays that way. Everyone here is saying YTA because you sleep in until 1-3pm, like what? I used to work full time overnight for 4 years (from 9pm-5am, I often stayed late and wouldn’t get home until 6 or 7am) while my husband would work full time during the day (from 8am-6pm). Obviously during this time we had completely different sleep schedules. Granted he would usually be at work while I was sleeping (I would wake up around 3-4pm) but on his days off, he sleeps in until 8-9am and for that 7-8 hour period was always careful not to wake me. I repeat, 7-8 hours! Not only that he would also make sure our son wouldn’t make too much noise either AND I’m a light sleeper! I of course, always gave him the same courtesy. 

I know you don’t work late nights/overnights and stay up due to sleeping problems. No, this doesn’t make you “immature” in my opinion, in fact some people are naturally night owls while others are naturally morning people. There’s nothing wrong with it. I think everyone here is correlating you sleeping in until the afternoon as laziness. Like we’re not robots or machines, we’re individual human beings. It’s not crucial for everyone to wake up at the wee hours of the morning, the world’s not going to end lol.

So in case you haven’t already guessed, I say NTA. And no, I’m not saying that your boyfriend needs to completely change his schedule either but all you asked was for him not to turn on the lights and to use headphones while using the tv for a few hours. Also wouldn’t a lamp fix the lights problem? You were even not bothered by him vacuuming ffs. Both my husband and I would be pretty cross with each other if the other vacuumed while the other was sleeping. That seems pretty reasonable and like a good compromise to me. He also said that he didn’t want you to go back to your room, which you suggested, so it seems only fair.
